title: Clause Width Bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $L$ and $A$ be finite lists of literals on $n$ coordinates. If the length of $L$ is at most the length of $A$ plus $3$, then every clause in the Tseitin clause chain formed from $L$ and $A$ has length at most $3$.
